_doc: Retired healers (FD-55 W0 / FD-4CR): healer_targets.json fragments whose code was deleted ON PURPOSE, each with the commit that deleted it (`commit`, an abbreviated SHA on main) and the row or step that owns the deletion (`by`). Reviewed list: adding an entry is the deliberate act that takes a deleted healer out of the probe-coverage denominator. targets.anchor_to marks a listed fragment `absent` with `deleted_by` ONLY when its code is actually gone from the product root under test (function deleted, or inline anchor lost); against an older product root that still has the code it stays measured. metrics.coverage computes coverage_pct over live fragments only (inventory minus retired); an absent or anchor_lost fragment that is NOT listed here stays in the denominator as unmeasured and fails the exact pin in tests/test_eval_e2e.py. Each later healer deletion (e.g. an FD-55 wave) adds its rows here in the same commit.
